cases.title: Paga Diario
cases.kicker: From notebooks and Excel to a real-time collections platform
cases.problem: Daily-collection microloan portfolios are usually kept in notebooks and Excel sheets. Paga Diario automates payment recording, late-fee calculation and reports, and organizes the collectors' routes.

decisions.title: Late fees under Colombian regulation
decisions.text: The calculation is automatic and follows the regulation instead of relying on manual math.

decisions.title: Real time without blocking the API
decisions.text: BullMQ on Redis and Socket.io for the live dashboard. Redis is optional: basic operation works without it.

decisions.title: Tested and deployed
decisions.text: Tests with Jest and Supertest, Docker containers and deployment on Fly.io.

results: Complete modules: loans, payments, collectors, expenses, bulk import, reports and Telegram alerts.
[Next step: an AI assistant that prioritizes the day's route and flags clients at risk of late payment]

cases.title: WhatsApp chatbot with vision
cases.kicker: An agent that reads purchase receipts and awards points on its own
cases.problem: The challenge: register campaign participants and process their purchase receipts with no human involvement. The chatbot identifies the person on WhatsApp, reads the photo of the receipt with AI and awards the points on the platform.

decisions.title: Explicit state machine
decisions.text: The conversation is modeled as 14 states, with 10 error cases handled.

decisions.title: Vision to read receipts
decisions.text: GPT-4o Vision extracts the data from the receipt the user photographs.

decisions.title: Iterate with tests
decisions.text: 11 automated tests and 12 critical fixes in version 2.0.0.

results: Delivered with 96% compliance and a 10/10 validation checklist.
[VIDEO: 30 s of the chat reading a real receipt]

cases.title: Pizzería Horebs
cases.kicker: From WooCommerce to a business run on data
cases.problem: The business lives on WordPress + WooCommerce, hosted on Hostinger. Orders, products and customers are all there, but nobody used them to make decisions. The goal: a new site with cart and checkout that is also the control center for the whole business.

decisions.title: Data before design
decisions.text: I connected an MCP server to the production MariaDB database to work with real orders and products from day one.

decisions.title: NestJS + Next.js + Supabase monorepo
decisions.text: API and web in a single repository, frontend on Vercel and free tiers to validate before paying for infrastructure.

decisions.title: New site first, migration later
decisions.text: Migrating historical customers and orders will be decided once the new site is running.

results: The data contradicted the brand: the best-selling product is the Ham and Cheese Pizza, not the one everyone assumed.
Done: monorepo, Supabase connection and /health endpoint. In progress: catalog, cart and checkout.

cases.title: AI Support Automation Platform
cases.kicker: A support agent that classifies, answers and acts
cases.problem: A platform that receives support tickets, classifies them by topic and urgency, answers with RAG over a knowledge base and takes actions with tool calling. When the agent is not sure, it escalates to a human.

decisions.title: Reuse what already works
decisions.text: The output uses the multichannel Strategy pattern from notificaciones-challenge, and the flows run on n8n-local.

decisions.title: Evals from day one
decisions.text: Traces and evaluations with Langfuse to measure classification accuracy and answer quality.

decisions.title: Human in the loop
decisions.text: If the agent's confidence is low, the ticket is escalated instead of answered.

results: [Goal: classification accuracy and % of tickets resolved without a human, measured with evals]
